webber.name: Webber
bio: Webber works as a maintenance worker at the facility, responsible for keeping the equipment and systems running smoothly. Part of the level 2 maintenance team, Webber is known for their handyman skills thanks to their multiple arms.
Dropping out of university, Webber decided to join Axion after seeing an ad for a maintenance position. They have been working with us ever since, and have proven to be a valuable asset to the team.
They seem to know the caretaker Nagi, apparently they used to be roomates during studying, and have been friends ever since..
It is to be known Webber is a content creator and has a live stream, need to make sure they do not leak any sensitive information about the facility.
positiveTraits: Able to make own web rope

somni.name: Somni
bio: Somni is a level 3 containment unit specialist at Axion, known for her expertise in handling any threat and all kinds of alien creatures.

Born on the planet, ████, Somni decided to join Axion after her desire to get away from her home planet. After a background check with her government, it seemed she was an outcast among her people. She was then recruited by Axion, and has been working with them ever since.

Somni is in possession of highly powerful ESP abilities, which she uses to her advantage in her work. It is a new type of magic, that is not present on Axion's home planet. She is also a skilled combatant, and is able to take down any threat that comes her way. Due to her powers she was able to ace all of our combat training, and is now one of our top containment agents.
She seems to have a liking for the caretaker, Nagi, and is often seen spending time with him during her breaks.

nagi.name: Nagi
bio: Nagi is a caretaker at the facility, known for his friendly demeanor and hardworking nature. Despite being clumsy and slow, he has a strong survival instinct and is dedicated to his duties.

Born on Axion's home planet, ████, Nagi worked to Level 3 access through his passion for caring and studying alien biology. He has a deep connection with the creatures under his care, often going above and beyond to ensure their well-being and his commitment to the facility's mission.

Nagi got consumed by alien creatures multiple times, yet always managed to escape unscathed, showcasing his resilience. Based on our records, the containment team specialist Somni is often called to retrieve him from these incidents.

skye.name: Skye
bio: Skye is a level 4 elite robotics expert that was hired by Axion after seeing their talent while they were still studying. They accepted our invitation to join our team, and have been working with us ever since. Skye is known for their superb understanding of robotics and their Artificial Intelligence, which makes them a valuable asset to our team.

Skye is a talented prodigy that has been working with robotics since they were a child. They have a natural talent for understanding how things work, and have been able to create some of the most advanced robots we have available.

They seem to have an obsession with the mech FF2400, affectionately called "Scarlet" which they have been known to spend months working on, after finishing their work on the mech, which was blueprinted by Dr. Mages.

a1.name: A1
bio: A1 is the head of the facility, they are responsible for overseeing all operations and making sure that everything runs smoothly. Most of the time A1 is stationed in the main control room, where their main body is connected to the facility's systems. A1 is a highly intelligent and capable of computing many different types of data at once with incredible speed.
A1 comes from an ocean planet called ████ . They cannot move at all outside of water, and are only able to move around the facility through their robotic body which was designed by Dr. Mages.

They are responsible for firing and dealing with bad employees, and are known for their strict and no-nonsense attitude. A1 is also known to be able to quickly deal with bad employees by cock voring them with their disposal unit and churning them into cum.
positiveTraits: Able to interact with electronics directly with their body
negativeTraits: Unable to move on land without their robotic body

dr.mages.name: Dr. Mages
bio: Dr. Mages is the lead scientist and head of the R&D department at the facility. They are one of the founding members of Axion, and have been working with the organization since its inception along with Sypher.

Mages is in possesion of an extremely powerful core artifact called "Heart of the Archmage" which is a powerful artifact that allows them to freely use any magic without needing to spend years of training. The only thing they need is to learn the incantations and the spell will be casted. This artifact is extremely powerful, and is one of the reasons why Mages is able to create such advanced technology.

Majority of tech at Axion has been designed by Mages, they love adding their own "quirks" that tend to be more on the sexual side, such as the "cum disposal unit" which is a device that is able to dispose of any unwanted personell, and is often used by A1 to dispose of bad employees.
Dr.Mages is often a target of Axion's enemies, and they have tried to kidnap them multiple times, but have always failed due to the security measures in place at the facility.

mellisa.name: Mellisa
bio: Mellisa is the head of the Biocare department at Axion, she is responsible for the production of the best healing and medical tools available. She produces healing honey from her breasts and stomach which is used to heal any injuries or even regrow lost limbs.

Found on planet ████, Mellisa was found weak, in an destroyed Hive, unable to survive on her own without the help of her hive. She was taken in by Axion, and has been working with them ever since. Axion provided Mellisa a section of the facility on level 4 that was converted into a hive.

Mellisa needs her workers to feed her, she has her own hive of workers that are responsible for feeding her and taking care of her needs. Mellisa can be a very seductive and hard to resist, as her pheromones cause mind control.
negativeTraits: Converts staff from other departments into her hive

gallery.caption: Playing with a converted staff member

reef.name: Reef
bio: Former hero of the ocean on planet Azuron, Reef was recruited by Axion after he was found mutated by a core artifact called the "Fang of the Abyss" He was uncontrollable and was causing havoc on his home planet, so he was taken in by Axion to be studied and to help him control his powers.

Axion managed to partially revert the transformation, thanks to ███████ █████, after which Reef was able to control himself again, and use the power of the artifact to his advangtage. Reef is now the head of security at the facility, and is responsible for keeping the facility safe from any threats and intruders.

He always wears the artifact around his neck, and gets withdrawals if hes seperated from it for too long. The artifact seems to influence his mind, and he needs to eat for two, to keep the artifact fed too, as it appears its some kind of living entity in itself.

wisp.name: Wisp
bio: Wisp was a former level 3 employee at Axion, during a containment breach Wisp was attacked by ███████ where her chest was crushed as her dying body was thrown by the creature into S-013, in which her soul fused with her body, shattering the artifact in the proccess. ,after "dying" and gaining new form Wisp was promoted to level 5 due to her new abilities.

Even after "death" Wisp continues to be highly religious, and swears she can see the souls of the dead, converse with them , and even able to see "the other side", as to what that exactly means remains unknown.
Her ghost form allows her to be fully immortal, as she does not appear to age, not get injured by any kind of attack. Which comes in very handy during visits of dangerous contained entities.

While Wisp usually has no corporeal form she can manifest a physical form temporarily, which she uses to interact with the world around her. She is also able to phase through walls and other solid objects, making her a valuable asset in containment situations.

sypher.name: Sypher
bio: Sypher is the richest man on the planet, and is the owner of Axion. He is a very powerful and influential man. How he got his wealth is unknown. He is a very private person, and very few people have seen him in person outside of the facility. He is known to be a very ruthless businessman, and will do whatever it takes to get what he wants.

Sypher lost his arm during █ ██████ ██████████ which caused an artifact to be stuck in his arm, this artifact allows him to ███████ ████ ██ ██ █ █████. But with the help of cybernetic enhancements by Dr. Mages, this can be pushed more all the way to █████████ ██ █████.
He founded Axion together with Dr.Mages, where he provides her with all the necessary funds, to create anything she wants to.
